feedback_and_control_causality: The physical mechanism must include an articulated body, two feet with actual ground contact, and six finite-torque lower-body actuators at the bilateral hip, knee, and ankle joints.

Use closed-loop feedback from measured body motion, joint state, and foot contact to keep the humanoid upright, limit lateral and vertical deviation, and sustain forward walking without prescribing the body trajectory.
These inputs must affect the connected contact, actuator-limit, and initial-condition mechanisms respectively.
